# Thirza Abernethy

## Overview

- **Age:** Over 50 years old  <sub>[v1 c9 P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>
- **Status:** Unmarried  <sub>[v1 c1 P31](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0031), [v1 c6 P34](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0034)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley, St. Brendan's Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c1 P7](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0007)</sub>
- **Role:** Homemaker and farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009), [v1 c6 P29](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0029)</sub>

## Appearance

Thirza has a tall, slender frame characterized by sharp angles rather than curves. She has dark hair streaked with gray, which she tightly binds at the back of her head in a firm bun held by wire hairpins. Her face is sallow and thin, with sharp contours and dark, perceptive eyes that eventually require spectacles.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c13 P11](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0011), [v1 c30 P0](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0000), [v1 c33 P15](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0015), [v2 c27 P2](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0002)_

## Personality

Thirza possesses a limited background and a rigid, unyielding sense of morality. Although she is sharp, abrupt, and maintains agonized standards of tidiness, she has a redeemed sense of humor and a deep, reserved capacity for affection. She strongly dislikes hypocrisy or picturing things as different from reality, often attempting to instill practical virtues in those around her. Despite her stern exterior, she shows profound compassion and quiet devotion to those in her care.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009), [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c4 P10](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0010), [v1 c5 P21](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0021), [v1 c7 P19](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0019), [v1 c8 P19](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0019), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003)_

- Strict and moral  <sub>[v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c7 P11](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0011)</sub>
- Exceedingly tidy and orderly  <sub>[v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009)</sub>
- Pragmatic and anti-romantic  <sub>[v1 c3 P20](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0020), [v1 c8 P19](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0019), [v1 c11 P8](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0008)</sub>

## Abilities

- Expert homemaking and cooking  <sub>[v1 c4 P23](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0023), [v1 c16 P27](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0027), [v1 c21 P12](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0012)</sub>

## Goals

- Raise and properly educate Nell Harcourt  <sub>[v1 c6 P34](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0034), [v1 c7 P13](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0013), [v1 c30 P16](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0016)</sub>
- Maintain the farmstead of Grey Shutters  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c38 P14](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0014)</sub>

## History

Thirza resides at Grey Shutters in Brierley with her quiet brother, Obed Abernethy. Expecting to take in an orphan boy to help on the farm, she is shocked when Obed brings home a fiery, red-haired eleven-year-old orphan girl named Nell Harcourt instead. Though initially determined to send Nell back, Thirza relents out of compassion for the girl's past and at Obed's quiet insistence. Over the years, Thirza works diligently to train the imaginative Nell in practical household skills, proper morality, and religion, gradually forming a fierce, motherly love for her. When Obed dies suddenly following the failure of the Abbey Bank, Thirza faces the prospect of losing Grey Shutters, but Nell decides to forego her college scholarship to teach locally and keep the farm. Eventually, after facing impending blindness that limits her labor, Thirza agrees to let Mrs. Agatha Sowerby move into Grey Shutters, allowing Nell to finally attend Wexcombe College. Thirza later takes in two orphan twins, Robin and Lucy Farrow. She experiences intense pride as Nell succeeds academically, wins the Avery Scholarship, and marries Dr. Hugh Carrow, the son of her own youthful suitor.

- Grew up in Brierley as the daughter of quiet parents  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c1 P31](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0031)</sub>
